shop: VoltKart (fictional online electronics shop selling in India and the US)

emails.text: Hi, I ordered the Sonix wireless earbuds (order VK-IN-55120) on 2 October and the tracking still says 'label created'. It's been 9 days. Where is my parcel?
My new 55-inch TV arrived with a cracked screen. The box had a big dent on one corner. I have photos. I need this fixed before my daughter's birthday party tomorrow.
I returned the smartwatch 3 weeks ago and the courier confirmed pickup, but I still haven't got my refund of Rs 8,499. Please check.
Do you ship the ProCam 4K webcam to Canada? And is there a bulk discount if I buy 25 for my office?
The power bank you sent is getting very hot while charging and there's a burning smell. I've unplugged it. Is it safe? What should I do?
My Bluetooth speaker won't pair with my iPhone after the latest update. It shows up in the list but then disconnects. I've tried restarting both.
I was charged twice for order VK-IN-55871. Two debits of Rs 12,999 each on my credit card. Please refund the extra one urgently, my card limit is blocked.
Hi! Is the Aura robot vacuum compatible with Alexa? And does it work on thick carpets?
Order VK-IN-56002 shows delivered but I never received it. Nobody in my building got it either. This is a laptop worth Rs 74,000.
How do I reset the SmartHub router to factory settings? The admin page won't load and I've lost my Wi-Fi password.
The headphones I received are the wrong colour. I ordered black, got white. Can I exchange them or should I return for a refund?
When will the Zen tablet be back in stock? I want to buy it as a gift before the end of next month.
My order was supposed to arrive yesterday for my sister's wedding today. Tracking hasn't moved from the Kochi hub for 2 days. Please help, I need it by this evening.
The fitness band screen has a dead line of pixels down the middle. It arrived like this, never dropped it.
The VoltKart app keeps crashing when I try to apply a coupon at checkout. I'm on Android 15. Can you fix it so I can complete my order?
I cancelled my order within 10 minutes but I was still charged $189. The order shows cancelled. When do I get my money back?
Is there an EMI option for the 65-inch OLED TV with HDFC credit cards? And is installation included?
Package says out for delivery since 8 am, it's now 9 pm. Is it still coming today? Order VK-US-30914.
The camera lens I received has a scratch inside the glass and the box seal was already broken. Looks used. I'm very unhappy.
My smart thermostat stopped working and the house is freezing, it's -5 outside. The display is blank even after changing batteries. Need help now.

notes: Counts: order_status 4, refund 4, damaged_item 4, technical_help 4, sales_question 4; urgency high 6 (ids 2,5,7,9,13,20), normal 14. Borderline cases decided in advance: #11 wrong colour = refund (asks exchange or refund, not damaged); #16 cancelled-but-charged = refund; #5 overheating = damaged_item + high (safety).
urgency_rule: high only for: a safety risk, money currently blocked, a high-value item missing, or a hard deadline within 1-2 days; everything else normal
